page.overview:
What is Bobbiedots?

The are helper bots that appear in Bobbiedots, Part 1 and Bobbiedots, Part 2 from the fourth and fifth books respectively in the Tales from the Pizzaplex book series. There are two generations of Bobbiedots: the first generation are physical animatronics, and the second generation are holograms.

The Generation 1 Bobbiedots in Abe's apartment are physical animatronics that are now decrepit and scorched. They all have a glowing oval on their forehead with their respective color. They also have wires which connect into the apartment.

The Generation 2 Bobbiedots are holograms and they are pretty similar to the Generation 1 Bobbiedots. They have gray skin and wear a white and gray bell bottom suit with a stripe in their respective theme color. They have a small oval on their forehead in their color. Their facial features are also in their color.

The Bobbidots all reside in the apartments of the Fazplex Tower. They can control all the appliances in the apartment to fit what the apartment owner wants. However, depending on the role they were programmed with, they can also control certain appliances that other Bobbiedots can't. For example, Gemini is in charge of media and entertainment, so she can put on movies in the TV and put music on whenever the owner likes. Generation 1 could control the appliances, but were limited by the wires connected to the apartment. The Generation 2 were holograms that can be used via glass panels on the walls.
